panel.title: Omatranslate
panel.detailWatch: Runs hidden in the background. A highlight shows a Translate chip; nothing is sent until you press it.
panel.detailPause: Stops watching but keeps the session in memory. Starts the background process when it isn't running.
panel.detailStop: Ends the background process. Open app brings it back, paused.
panel.manual: Highlight text in your PDF reader, then press Translate. Nothing translates by itself.
